author: Arjun Deshmukh (Drilling Engineer)
text: Recorded a critical kick at 1300m and high mud loss at 900m in this well -- both inside the Mumbai High Limestone's vuggy/fractured interval (650-1350m). Recommend offset wells in this field carry LCM on standby and hold mud weight at the upper end of the program through that interval.

author: Nabajit Phukan (Drilling Engineer)
text: High mud loss at 3193m required a full LCM pill and cost significant NPT. Cementing issue earlier at 2394m may be related to washouts from the same loss zone -- worth reviewing cement bond logs together with the mud loss record for this well.

author: Rohit Mahanta (Drilling Engineer)
text: Three offset wells in this field (OIL-SYN-001, 007, 013) all recorded high mud loss around 1650-1700m followed by stuck pipe around 2040-2070m. Watch ECD and mud weight closely as we approach that interval -- same pattern across all three suggests it's tied to this field's geology, not one-off well conditions.
